description: A React component for calculating and inputting seat counts for a subscription, including validation and display of total costs.

classes.name: Seats
classes.description: Interface defining the structure for seat quantity and error message.

methods.name: calculateMaxUsers
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of users supported based on annual price per seat, considering transaction limit.

methods.name: validateSeats
methods.description: Validates the seat input string against min/max constraints and returns a Seats object with error messages if invalid.
